verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the account-merging doc, which says merging "keeps Poke's Memory" from the selected account. That confirms Memory is a first-party, persisted, account-level feature, but nothing describes what it stores or how it is applied in new conversations. missing for 10: documentation of what Memory remembers from previous chats, how remembered context is applied in new conversations, user controls to view/edit/delete memories, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
